mechanism: Triamcinolone increases amphotericin B nephrotoxicity by enhancing renal tubular damage and potassium wasting, while amphotericin B increases corticosteroid-induced immunosuppression and hyperglycemia risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and blood glucose closely; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose; consider lipid formulation of amphotericin B to reduce nephrotoxicity.
